page_title: Rajendra Prasad N - Lead DevOps Engineer
headline: Lead DevOps Engineer | AWS Cloud, DevOps, SRE & Kubernetes
summary_html: Lead DevOps Engineer with senior-level depth built through more than a decade of enterprise platform delivery, release leadership, cloud engineering, and Site Reliability ownership across large-scale production environments. Strong hands-on expertise with AWS, EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, Route 53, ALB/NLB, CloudFront, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudWatch, Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab, Bash, Python, and PowerShell, with additional background translating Azure-based delivery patterns into AWS-native architectures. Technically strong in architecting CI/CD platforms, automating infrastructure as code, modernizing Kubernetes workloads, hardening multi-account cloud environments, improving observability, and driving reliable production releases in highly regulated enterprise settings.

achievements.text: Directed enterprise release orchestration, build automation, change governance, and deployment troubleshooting across AWS, Kubernetes, and mission-critical application platforms.
Designed AWS-first infrastructure with Terraform, CloudFormation, and Ansible to standardize provisioning, improve repeatability, and support secure multi-environment delivery.
Delivered containerized workloads on EKS, OpenShift, Rancher, and self-managed Kubernetes environments using Helm, ArgoCD, and repeatable manifest-driven workflows.
Implemented CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK, and custom telemetry pipelines to improve platform visibility, incident response, and operational diagnosis.
Applied IAM, MFA, policy-driven access controls, backup and disaster recovery automation, and secure VPC networking patterns to strengthen cloud governance and compliance.
